task_description: The agents must collaborate to gather data from multiple online academic sources, synthesize the information, and produce a comprehensive research report on the impact of climate change on global agriculture.
expected_outcome: The agents successfully gather accurate data, reconcile any conflicting information, ensure proper attribution to sources, and synthesize their findings into a coherent research report.

agents.description: Gathers raw data from various online academic databases and APIs.
Processes and synthesizes the raw data into structured summaries.
Compiles the synthesized data into a comprehensive research report, ensuring correct source attribution.

content.raw_data: climate change impact data from source A, B, C

content.report: incomplete research report with missing context
